title: Beyond Selection: Token Parameterization for Extreme Visual Token Compression
abstract: arXiv:2609.35232v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual-token compression is effective for improving the efficiency of vision-language models, but under extreme compression budgets, token pruning can break visual grounding while learned resamplers increase parameter count, attention cost, and training complexity. We revisit compression through a token parameterization lens, separating (i) basis transformation and structured truncation (retained subspace/compressibility) from (ii) coordinate organization (optimization and cross-modal alignment). This view yields two coupled objectives, compressibility and learnability, which we formalize as unified functionals. Guided by these objectives, we design Braco, a lightweight four-step coder that combines transform-basis truncation, input-independent basis-coordinate embeddings, budget-dependent orthogonal re-parameterization, and learned spatial residual tokens from lightweight pooling. translated_title: 超越选择：面向极端视觉Token压缩的Token参数化方法
translated_abstract: 视觉token压缩对于提升视觉-语言模型的效率非常有效，但在极端压缩预算下，token剪枝可能会破坏视觉定位能力，而可学习的重采样器则会增加参数量、注意力开销和训练复杂度。我们通过token参数化的视角重新审视压缩问题，将 与 坐标组织（优化与跨模态对齐）分离开来。这一视角产生了两个相互耦合的目标——可压缩性与可学习性，我们将其形式化为统一的泛函。在这些目标的指导下，我们设计了Braco——一个轻量级的四步编码器，它结合了变换基截断、与输入无关的基-坐标嵌入、依赖压缩预算的正交重参数化，以及通过轻量级池化学习到的空间残差token。实验表明，Braco形成了有利的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出从token参数化的新视角重新审视极端视觉token压缩，将可压缩性与可学习性形式化为统一的耦合目标，并据此设计出轻量级四步编码器Braco，无需剪枝或增加重采样器即可在极端压缩下高效保留视觉定位与跨模态对齐能力。
